messages:
Leah: FYI Orca POC warmup hitting 429s as concurrency ramps, demo later today. Can we swarm? :eyes:
Noah: On it. Which endpoint and model?
Leah: /v1/generate -> rwd-large-16k (hosted). Customer on a dedicated trial but we fell back to hosted. Seeing spikes around 11:07 UTC.
Ivy: Adding logs — gateway shows rate_limit active. req_id=xyz-987 ts=1795016842 status=429.
Ivy: Last gateway snippet:
```
[11:07:21] conn=10.4.2.7 req=xyz-985 path=/v1/generate model=rwd-large-16k concurrency=46 -> 429
[11:07:22] conn=10.4.2.9 req=xyz-986 path=/v1/generate model=rwd-large-16k concurrency=51 -> 429
[11:07:23] autoscaler: scale_pending=1 desired_pools=4
```
Mateo: We're at soft quota for hosted GPUs in us-west2 for this org. Autoscaler requested nodes but cloud queue delayed. Raising with cloud now.
Leah: Customer timeline: internal demo 16:00 local. Need mitigation in ~90m.
Noah: Short term: can we route traffic to compatible rwd-large-8k shard? Slightly different perf but avoids 429s.
Ivy: I can add a temporary routing override for org=orca-enterprise -> rwd-large-8k for 45m. Applying now.
Ivy: Routing override applied for org=orca-enterprise -> rwd-large-8k :white_check_mark:
Leah: Notified customer: "Temporarily routed to a compatible model to avoid errors; no billing change while hosted. Output may vary slightly."
Leah: Customer replied asking about SOC2 summary and Dedicated SLA, attached a security questionnaire PDF.
Noah: I'll surface SOC2 letter + Dedicated SLA PDF to Leah. Ping if they want an explainer call.
Priya: I'll tag billing records with model_override=rwd-large-8k so metering is traceable.
OpsBot: [11:12:05] autoscale.request created (team=infra target_size=5)
Mateo: Cloud update: new node ETA ~22m. Will scale pools when node is ready.
Ivy: Triage summary: root cause = quota exhaustion + autoscaler provisioning lag. Mitigation = routing override -> rwd-large-8k, notify customer, escalate cloud quota.
Leah: Customer acknowledged: "Thanks — demo looks good if you can keep latency steady. Please send SOC2 + SLA."
Mateo: Follow-ups: open quota increase ticket with cloud, schedule load test simulating demo load, add warmup guidelines for trials.
Noah: Action items:
- Share SOC2 + Dedicated SLA (Noah)
- Billing note for temporary model fallback (Priya)
- Draft runbook addition for demo warmups + pool headroom (Ivy)
- Quota request + QA load test (Mateo)
Leah: Thanks all. Marking this resolved for now, will reopen if we hit anything else. :party:
Ivy: Closing war-room; I'll write a short incident note tomorrow with timeline and follow-ups.
